purpose: Define a versioned, deterministic, fail-closed evidence intake and tracked-work template for change events that require separately governed deployment-specific reassessment. The template neither monitors sources nor determines legal, regulatory, release, authority, policy, or runtime outcomes.

verified_facts: Neural Brain is product- and domain-neutral and has no accepted scoped customer or domain integration.
The repository does not establish a concrete deployment, applicable jurisdiction, operating entity, legal source, qualified guidance, supplier, model, data flow, or release decision.
The protected Memory Core is an internal subsystem and cannot narrow the complete cognitive-system product boundary established by ADR-018.
unknown_facts_not_inferred: whether an external legal, regulatory, standards, guidance, supplier, model, purpose, data, or deployment event has occurred
whether a concrete event changes an obligation, classification, applicability, risk, lawfulness, authority, policy, release, or runtime decision
whether a concrete deployment may be released, operated, process data, or cause an external effect

trigger_intake_template.assessment_unit: One immutable trigger-evidence record and one linked tracked reassessment work item per concrete change event, artifact version or digest, proposed deployment, intended purpose, and authenticated Tenant, Area, and Project scope combination.
deterministic_intake_order: Verify every required event field, immutable evidence reference, authenticated scope binding, accountable owner, qualified reviewer or escalation recipient, due or review trigger, and tracked-work-item reference; any missing, unknown, stale, contradictory, or scope-mismatched fact is incomplete.
Classify the recorded event only by one or more mandatory trigger types; unrecognized, ambiguous, or compound events are retained as unknown-and-escalate and do not receive an allow outcome.

Create or link exactly one tracked reassessment work item with owner, open status, next step, due date or review trigger, affected evidence references, and an explicit non-bypass release boundary before any deployment-specific release decision relying on the affected evidence.

Preserve the original evidence and prior assessment references; a reassessment work item requests separately governed review and cannot amend, expire, supersede, or reactivate an authority, policy, approval, release, or protected-state record.
Close the tracked work item only through separately governed qualified reassessment evidence and a separate release decision where one is required; closure has no runtime or authority effect.

authority_boundary.template_is: a versioned governance and traceability intake for a human- or system-reported change event and separately governed reassessment work
template_is_not: background polling, source surveillance, legal research, or a claim that any external change was detected
legal advice, a legal or regulatory determination, a risk classification, or a finding of lawfulness or compliance
a deployment, processing, productive-use, or release approval
an authority grant, policy decision, approval, delegation, Security Floor override, or authenticated runtime context
a protected-state transition request, Gate decision, runtime command, or runtime capability enablement
an implementation, maturity, recognition, safety, or production-autonomy claim
authority_boundary.non_bypass_boundary: A trigger record and its tracked reassessment work item cannot waive, compensate for, reorder, or satisfy a Security Floor prohibition, Protected Control Plane gate, transition gate, independent verification, delivery-stage gate, recognition gate, or release stop. Only separately authorized governance with complete current evidence may decide a concrete reassessment or release.

current_blocker.unblock_condition: A concrete proposed deployment supplies an immutable change-evidence record, every required scope and prior-evidence reference, accountable owner, qualified review or escalation recipient, linked tracked reassessment work item, and separately governed reassessment and release evidence where required.
current_blocker.next_step: For each reported qualifying change, preserve the evidence and create the linked open reassessment work item before relying on affected deployment-specific evidence.
